title: Genetic regulations of citrus flowering: insights towards climatic factors and modern biotechnological approaches.
authors: Singh, Pradeep; Thakur, Gitika; Sharma, Vishal; Singh, Jagveer; Sharma, Ankush
one_liner_zh: 综述柑橘开花遗传调控及气候因素，提及转录因子和AI/ML工具，但未聚焦蛋白质-DNA互作建模，仅泛泛涉及，与本课题关联度低。
abstract: The review highlights the intricate relationship between genetic and molecular mechanisms that regulate floral development and responses in citrus under diverse climatic conditions. Citrus, the world's top traded and third most produced fruit crop, holds great economic importance and provides essential nutrients, antioxidants, and medicinal properties, including anti-cancer and anti-microbial benefits. Global climatic changes and patterns pose a notable impact on the quantity and quality of blooms in mature citrus trees every year. The regulation of flowering in citrus is a complex process influenced by genetic mechanisms, along with various climatic stressors like variations in temperature, water stress and changes during vegetative phase transitions and many more. Amid unfavorable climatic scenarios, identifying robust citrus genotypes and understanding the interplay between various genetic regulatory genes and transcription factors becomes crucial and challenging for developing climate-resilient citrus varieties. In this review, detailed mechanisms of flowering in citrus have been discussed with a focus on key genetic players, such as genes and transcription factors governing the floral developmental processes. External climatic factors and their interactions with molecular pathways, influencing floral induction and development have been highlighted. Finally, the integration of modern biotechnological tools like CRISPR/Cas9, multi-omics approaches, nanomaterials, biosensors, artificial intelligence and machine learning, as a comprehensive framework to enhance stress resilience and achieve sustainable citrus production has been emphasized.
abstract_zh: 本综述重点探讨了在不同气候条件下调控柑橘花发育及响应的遗传与分子机制之间的复杂关系。柑橘作为全球交易量最大、产量第三的水果作物，具有重要的经济价值，并提供必需营养素、抗氧化剂及药用特性，包括抗癌和抗微生物益处。全球气候变化及其模式每年对成熟柑橘树的开花数量和质量产生显著影响。柑橘开花的调控是一个复杂过程，受遗传机制以及多种气候胁迫因素（如温度变化、水分胁迫、营养期转变期间的变化等）的影响。在不利气候情景下，识别稳健的柑橘基因型并理解各种遗传调控基因与转录因子之间的相互作用，对于开发气候适应性柑橘品种至关重要且具有挑战性。本综述详细讨论了柑橘开花的机制，重点关注关键遗传因子，如调控花发育过程的基因和转录因子。同时，强调了外部气候因素及其与分子途径的相互作用对花诱导和发育的影响。最后，强调了整合现代生物技术工具，如CRISPR/Cas9、多组学方法、纳米材料、生物传感器、人工智能和机器学习，作为增强胁迫耐受性并实现可持续柑橘生产的综合框架。
